newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS, SEND NZ IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND WIN TOSS, SEND NZ IN TO BAT.

text.p: England won the toss and sent New Zealand in to bat in the third and final test at Lancaster Park on Friday.
England named an unchanged side from that which won the second test by an innings and 68 runs at the Basin Reserve in Wellington last Monday, to lead the series 1-0.
New Zealand have made two changes from the second test.
Batsman Matt Horne comes in for his test debut and fast bowler Heath Davis is recalled after a 2-1/2 year absence for his second test.
Davis takes off-spinner Dipak Patels place and Adam Parore, who was dropped after the second test, comes back as a replacement for injured wicketkeeper and captain Lee Germon.
Batsman Stephen Fleming takes over the captaincy to become New Zealands youngest ever test captain. He is 24 on April 1.
The pitch is expected to provide some assistance to the pace bowlers early on.
New Zealand - Blair Pocock, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Simon Doull, Heath Davis, Geoff Allott, Daniel Vettori.
England - Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Dominic Cork, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andrew Caddick, Phil Tufnell.
